subject: Request: pilot credit amnesty for Ellum Health trial
messages:
From: Sara Lane <sara@ellumhealth.com>
To: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 01 Jul 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Pilot wrap-up — quick ask on trial credits

Hi Sean,

Quick note from our side — our technical evaluation of Redwood wrapped up last week but we had a hard stop when the sandbox credits expired mid-test. We still have two key feature validations (structured output and latency at scale) that the product team needs to finish. The pilot was otherwise on track and the PMs are asking if Redwood can provide a short credit extension so we can complete the tests and finalize our internal recommendation next month.

Estimated additional usage: ~18k tokens over the next 2 weeks (mostly generation).

I've attached our one-page evaluation plan for context (ellum_evaluation_plan.pdf). If there's a quick commercial route (trial top-up or promo), we'd be grateful. If procurement needs a formal request, loop them in: procurement@ellumhealth.com.

Thanks,
Sara Lane
Senior Product Manager
Ellum Health

--
Attachment: ellum_evaluation_plan.pdf (application/pdf, 1 page)

From: Sean Gallagher <sean_gallagher@redwood.com>
To: Sara Lane <sara@ellumhealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Avery Johnson <avery_johnson@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 02 Jul 2027 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Pilot wrap-up — quick ask on trial credits

Hi Sara — thanks for the plan and context, really helpful. Glad the pilot is progressing.

I can kick off a short-term "amnesty" style top-up while we confirm approvals. Two quick asks so I can move faster with Ops:
- Can you confirm the exact token estimate (18k looks fine, but do you expect bursts or steady usage?)
- Who should we send the SOW/addendum to on your procurement side (is it procurement@ellumhealth.com or a named contact)?

Provisional offer: I can provision a 10k token top-up immediately (no charge) to let you finish blocking tests. If you need the full 18k, I will escalate to Marissa for a discretionary promotional grant. If procurement needs paperwork, we'll prepare a short addendum.

If that's acceptable I'll add the 10k today and follow up here with next steps for additional credit.

—Sean
Sean Gallagher
Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Date: Sat, 03 Jul 2027 11:22:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: Pilot wrap-up — quick ask on trial credits

Looping in for approval. Quick notes from sales perspective:
- Ellum is in late-stage evaluation; PMs are the primary champions and engineering support is solid.
- They requested ~18k; Sean offered 10k provisional. Given strategic fit (healthcare analytics use case, potential ARR $120k ARR), I recommend we grant a one-time promotional grant of 25k tokens + a 30-day sandbox extension to remove friction and keep momentum.
- Condition: require a signed SOW addendum that records the promotional concession so Finance can mark it correctly (promotional_concession). I can draft that and route for signature.

If you approve this I will prepare the addendum and confirm the DocuSign link.

—Marissa
Director, Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
